brand_identity.name: Travaholic Stays
design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix editorial print layouts with digital interactivity.
Emotion First: Every interaction should feel like a deep breath.
Content is King: Large, immersive imagery takes precedence over UI chrome.
Negative Space: Generous padding (2x-3x standard) to create luxury.
Contrast: Sharp typography against soft, neutral backgrounds.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-sm uppercase tracking-widest transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-sm uppercase tracking-widest transition-all duration-300
buttons.ghost: text-primary hover:text-accent hover:bg-transparent px-4 py-2 text-sm uppercase tracking-widest transition-colors

cards.villa_listing: group relative overflow-hidden bg-card border border-border/50 transition-all duration-500 hover:shadow-hover
cards.feature: bg-muted/30 p-8 border border-border/50 flex flex-col gap-4 hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors

inputs.default: bg-transparent border-b border-border rounded-none px-0 py-4 focus:border-primary focus:ring-0 placeholder:text-muted-foreground/50 transition-colors

hero.style: Full-screen immersive imagery with centered, elegant typography.
hero.structure: h-screen w-full relative flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden

listings.style: Asymmetrical 'Bento' grid or staggered list to avoid repetition.
listings.structure: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8 md:gap-12

details.style: Editorial layout. Large sticky images on one side, scrollable content on the other.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL DEPENDENCIES: Run `yarn add framer-motion @studio-freight/lenis @phosphor-icons/react` immediately.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update `tailwind.config.js` with the colors and fonts defined in `design_system`.
3. IMPORT FONTS: Add Playfair Display and Manrope from Google Fonts in `index.css`.
4. OVERRIDE CSS VARS: Update `index.css` :root variables to match the 'Light' theme colors exactly.
5. CREATE LAYOUTS: Build the 'Hero' and 'VillaListing' components first using the defined strategies.
6. USE IMAGES: Use the provided Unsplash URLs for placeholders. DO NOT use gray boxes.
7. DATA-TESTID: Ensure every interactive element has a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='book-now-btn'`).
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': No generic centered layouts or default blue/purple gradients.
Dark colors must be solid, not gradients.
Use glassmorphism sparingly (only for sticky navs).
Micro-animations are mandatory for all interactions.
Spacing should be 2x-3x standard (e.g., p-12 instead of p-4).
Never use emoji icons; use proper SVG icons.
